name: Jingtao Yao
evidence: Identity first: there is NO author named 'Jingtao Yao' on arXiv 2604.06210. The title-page author block read from the PDF (2604.06210v4, ICML 2026) is: Jaehyeok Lee(1), Xiaoyuan Yi*(2), Jing Yao(2), Hyunjin Hwang(1), Roy Ka-Wei Lee(3), Xing Xie(2), JinYeong Bak*(1), with 1=Sungkyunkwan University, 2=Microsoft Research Asia, 3=Singapore University of Technology and Design; the same seven-name list appears in the repo's BibTeX at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JaehyeokLee-119/DOVE/main/README.md. So the CSV string 'Jingtao Yao' is a corrupted rendering of 'Jing Yao' (Microsoft Research Asia). Address: the paper itself prints only xiaoyuanyi@microsoft.com, jy.bak@skku.edu and hjl8708@skku.edu (correspondence/contact footnote), none for Jing Yao. Her address is printed verbatim in two of her own first-author papers: arXiv:2311.10766 'Value FULCRA' - author block 'Jing Yao(1), Xiaoyuan Yi(1), Xiting Wang(2,3), Yifan Gong(1), Xing Xie(1); 1 Microsoft Research Asia, Beijing, China' with the braced address line '{jingyao, xiaoyuanyi, v-yifangong, xing.xie}@microsoft.com'; and arXiv:2407.10725 'CLAVE' - 'Jing Yao, Xiaoyuan Yi*, Xing Xie / Microsoft Research Asia / {jingyao,xiaoyuanyi,xing.xie}@microsoft.com'. Both were read directly from the PDFs, and the braced form expands unambiguously to jingyao@microsoft.com (decoded from the printed brace-list notation, not a name-pattern guess). Anchors ruling out a namesake: identical MSRA affiliation, two shared co-authors with 2604.06210 (Xiaoyuan Yi and Xing Xie), and the same research line (LLM value alignment/evaluation), with Value FULCRA cited inside 2604.06210's own reference list. Rejected: the alphaXiv researcher record for 'Jing Yao' (SLUG=jing-yao-2), which resolves to an Assistant Professor at the Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences working on hyperspectral remote sensing - a different person, no MSRA/value-alignment anchor; also rejected the unrelated 'JingTao Yao' (rough-set researcher). No address constructed from any institutional pattern.
